title: mcp-atlassian DNS-rebinding TOCTOU bypass of the SSRF fix
summary: mcp-atlassian (PyPI) before 0.22.0 validates the attacker-controlled X-Atlassian-Jira-Url / X-Atlassian-Confluence-Url header host once at middleware time (the CVE-2026-27826 fix), but the outbound request is later built with the raw hostname and re-resolves at connect time with no IP pinning. A DNS-rebinding name that returns a public IP during validation and an internal IP at connect time bypasses the SSRF guard. Fixed in 0.22.0.
